asset_rules: Exactly one empty 180 by 18 minimized surface at top-left.
No title text, pseudo-text, icon, button, body, control, or extra window.
canvas: Return an 1120 by 480 output canvas, four times the 280 by 120 reference.
Place the four-times minimized donor at x=0 y=0 with source-scale size 180 by 18; fill all other pixels with a flat neutral white review field.
Resolve a new compact right endcap at x=179.
negative_constraints: No simple crop, clipped body, squeezed expanded window, open right edge, modern rounded card, soft shadow, glass, gibberish, or magenta desktop background.
objective: Create a coherent minimized-state chrome donor for the exact Japanese 基本情報 window. Recompose the 280 by 120 window into a compact 180 by 18 title bar at the top-left. It must be a newly resolved late-1990s Japanese game-window endpoint, never a crop of the expanded window.
preservation_invariants: Keep source pixel scale, palette family, hard aliased edges, and one-pixel line weights.
The minimized bar occupies source-scale x=0..179, y=0..17 and has complete left, top, right, and bottom chrome.
Do not retain, crop, squash, or ghost any identity, meter, value, page button, level, footer, or body pixel.
Do not include title glyphs, title icon, or title button; those remain separate editable elements.
quality_checks: The compact bar has four complete edges and a continuous empty title surface.
The endpoint reads as regenerated chrome rather than a crop.
reference_role: Reference image 1 is the authoritative 280 by 120 基本情報 window and fixes the pixel density, dark and pale blue title gradient, one-pixel chrome, and source raster character.

regions.change: Remove the complete body and recompose only the empty title chrome as a compact 180 by 18 bar with a continuous source-matched blue gradient and a complete right endcap.
